## Activity

During March 2025, North City Eye Clinic completed 563 retinal image captures. This activity reflects the volume recorded at the clinic during the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading review.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 18 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.2 per cent of all captures. The clinic should continue to monitor image acquisition and record recurring camera issues with the service desk, as requested by the clinic lead.

## Grading

Grading identified 140 referable results. These results should be managed in line with the relevant clinical pathway and local follow-up arrangements. The median lag from image capture to completion of grading was 1 day. Monitoring this interval alongside the volume of referable results will support routine oversight of the service and help identify any emerging operational issues.
